annotation.title_clean: Harnessing Embodied Agents: Runtime Governance for Policy-Constrained Execution
annotation.title_en: Harnessing Embodied Agents: Runtime Governance for Policy-Constrained Execution
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Qin, X.; Luan, S.; See, J.; Boukhers, Z.; Yang, C.; Li, Z.
annotation.summary_en: Technical preprint proposing an externalized Runtime Governance Layer for embodied agents, performing capability admission, policy checking, execution monitoring, rollback and human override. Simulation trials show 96.2% interception of unauthorized actions and 90.7% recovery success, outperforming guardrail baselines in continuous runtime detection.
key_provisions_or_claims: Separate agent cognition from execution oversight via a dedicated runtime governance layer
Pipeline: capability admission, policy guard, execution watcher, recovery/rollback, human override
96.2% interception of unauthorized actions over 1000 randomized trials
Unsafe continuation reduced from 100% to 22.2% under runtime drift
Pre-execution filtering alone lacks continuous runtime detection (RVDR 61.3% vs 0%)
